ctx.x: He only had three. And the second Papa Celestine, myself. Clown, uh, Clown Hall, Joe Harris, I forget who's playing third, something. Well, my name is Creek, but he's out of town. Uh, John Porter, who's playing here. And, uh, Bob Orgin.
